en-US.title: Lantai
en-US.subtitle: Flare for Notion
en-US.promotionalText: Point a zero-edit Shortcut at any Notion database you already use. Pick fields, run one shortcut named Lantai.
en-US.description:
Lantai (Flare for Notion) turns a verified Shortcuts workflow into an iOS app: connect Notion, pick a database you already have, choose which properties to capture, run one fixed-name shortcut. Your Notion database stays the source of truth — we store configs and quotas, not your rows.

WHAT IT IS

• Your databases, your properties
• One shortcut named Lantai — no three-place renaming
• Optional starters (journal, inbox, links, habits) if you want a name preset

WHAT IT IS NOT

• Not an AI capture app
• Not a Notion charts SaaS
• Not a replacement for your Notion workspace
• Not available on the China App Store

Published by UseONE, LLC. Privacy and support: lantai.hexastral.com
